{{Quote|The Empire has a prototype weapon called the Neutralizer which puts out an energy field that disables all standard-issue Republic weaponry.|Garik|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Garik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the start of the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Upper Sundari Outpost]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to sabotage the [[Neutralizer (device)|Neutralizer]], a weapon being used by the Empire to disable the Republic weapons.
